name: The Receiving Hand
pitch: Keep every art slot empty: each one catches an enemy art whole, they still pay for it, and when your hands are full they have no ward and you have a fist.

new.name: Catching Hand
new.effect: Each empty art slot catches one enemy art hit per fight: the art fires and pays, and its hit deals nothing and drains nothing.
new.second_home: any art build that leaves one slot open against an opening strike

new.name: Returned Force
new.effect: A caught art adds half its c_art to your next basic attack's coefficient.

new.name: Ten Thousand Strikes
new.effect: +0.1 to the basic attack's coefficient per power of ten of basic attacks landed this life, up to +0.7.

new.name: Hollow Palm
new.effect: 50 % of a basic attack becomes qi, keeping its body tags.
new.second_home: any body build short of ward-breaking

new.name: Iron-Sand Hand Bath
new.effect: +25 points to body hits, prepared before the fight.

new.name: Vow of the Open Hand
new.effect: Catching Hand holds one catch per empty slot and Empty Hand counts every empty slot; any slot that holds an art after the Vow is stained for life and never counts as empty again.

new.name: Waiting Hands Method
new.effect: Body technique, Thiên giai, with no arts in it by design; lists Callus Road.

new.name: Knuckle Wraps
new.effect: New weapon base: attack 20, defence 10, thần thức 10.

new.name: Callus Road
new.effect: Sealed, theme body cultivation, Earth, size 7: Basic attack damage, body guard, Ten Thousand Strikes.

new.name: Way of the Bare Hand
new.effect: Requires a body technique, no element. Branches Receiving, Striking, Waiting; keystone Vow of the Open Hand. Holds no art nodes.

questions: Rule 13 tags the basic attack art. Should art modifiers reach it? If yes, On the Beat is always true for every basic attack in the game. If no, this build still wins one realm up, at 6 s on 24 %.
Is a stained slot too cold, or the right kind of cold?
